description: This header file declares functions related to Lua condition handling within the lighttpd server, including initialization, condition retrieval, pushing conditions onto Lua stack, and setting global condition values.

methods.name: li_lua_init_condition_mt
methods.description: Initializes the Lua metatable for condition objects in the given Lua state.

methods.name: li_lua_get_condition
methods.description: Retrieves a condition object from the Lua stack at the specified index.

methods.name: li_lua_push_condition
methods.description: Pushes a condition object onto the Lua stack, associated with the server.

methods.name: li_lua_set_global_condition_lvalues
methods.description: Sets global Lua variables based on server condition values.
